hero.intro: Welcome to the world of Haydar Durmuş. With more than five decades dedicated to the visual arts, Haydar remains a lifelong student of craft, constantly exploring new techniques and mediums. Here, you can immerse yourself in his extensive 2,500-piece portfolio or discover his unique art house, which proudly showcases 200 artworks by over 100 fellow painters. We invite you to explore his studio—harmoniously nestled in the nature of the Black Sea region—and discover the inspiration behind the canvas.
